title: The Effect of Low-Skill Immigration Restrictions on US Firms and Workers: Evidence from a Randomized Lottery
title_zh: 低技能移民限制对美国企业与工人的影响：来自随机抽签的证据
authors: Michael A. Clemens, Ethan G. Lewis
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：Crossref
abstract: US firms hiring foreign workers in low-skill nonfarm jobs face a binding quota on the “H-2B” visa, allocated in part through a randomized lottery. We evaluate the quota’s marginal impact using the lottery, a novel firm survey, and a pre-analysis plan. Firms exogenously employing more H-2B workers in low-skill jobs increase production (elasticity 0.20–0.22), investment (1.5–2.1), and profits (0.15). The elasticity of substitution between H-2B and US workers is very low (0.8–2.2). Thus, the effect on US employment is zero or positive overall, and positive in rural areas. Forensic analysis suggests similarly low substitutability of black-market labor. (JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37)
abstract_zh: 美国企业在低技能非农岗位雇佣外籍工人时，面临“H-2B”签证的约束性配额，该配额部分通过随机抽签分配。我们利用抽签机制、一项新颖的企业调查以及预分析计划，评估了该配额的边际影响。在低技能岗位中因外生因素雇佣更多H-2B工人的企业，其产量（弹性0.20–0.22）、投资（1.5–2.1）和利润（0.15）均有所提升。H-2B工人与美国工人之间的替代弹性极低（0.8–2.2）。因此，该配额对美国就业的整体影响为零或为正，且在乡村地区呈现正向效应。法证分析表明，黑市劳动力的可替代性同样较低。（JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37）

title: Disruptions to Foreign Trade and U.S. Banks' Returns
title_zh: 外贸中断与美国银行收益
authors: Michele Modugno, Dino Palazzo, Carlos A. Ramírez, Thiago R.T. Ferreira
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a market-based measure of firms' and industries' exposure to foreign trade disruptions. Combining this approach with detailed supervisory data, we quantify large U.S. banks' exposure to such disruptions and propose a novel bank-level vulnerability index. We show that banks with greater exposure experienced significantly larger stock price declines following the April 2025 tariff announcements. Our vulnerability index explains 18% of the cross-sectional variation in bank returns during this episode.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种基于市场的企业及行业对外贸易中断风险敞口度量方法。结合详尽的监管数据，我们量化了美国大型银行对此类风险的敞口程度，并提出了一种新颖的银行层面脆弱性指数。研究表明，在2025年4月关税政策宣布后，风险敞口较大的银行股价跌幅显著更大。该脆弱性指数可解释此轮银行股收益率截面差异的18%。

title: Air Pollution and Cognitive Performance Under Varying Task Complexity
title_zh: 不同任务复杂度下的空气污染与认知表现
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how short-term variations in fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution affects cognitive performance across tasks of varying complexity. While prior work shows that pollution impairs performance in highly demanding cognitive settings, it remains unclear whether these effects extend to simpler tasks. We examine this question using data from official Rubik's Cube tournaments in the United States and India. Solving different cube sizes provides a natural proxy for task complexity, while solving time measures cognitive performance. To identify causal effects, we exploit exogenous variation in local PM2.5 generated by wind direction. We find that PM2.5 pollution has negligible effects on simple tasks but significantly slows performance on complex ones for tournaments in the United States. In India, where baseline PM2.5 levels are substantially higher, we find similar effect patterns but none of the effects are statistically significant. We show that this pattern is explained by diminishing marginal sensitivity to short-term PM2.5 shocks as baseline PM2.5 pollution levels increase. Our findings provide causal evidence that the cognitive costs of PM2.5 pollution depend critically on task complexity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染的短期波动如何影响不同复杂度任务中的认知表现。尽管已有研究表明污染会损害高认知需求环境下的表现，但尚不清楚这些影响是否延伸至简单任务。我们利用美国和印度官方魔方锦标赛的数据来探究这一问题。不同尺寸魔方的解法可作为任务复杂度的自然代理变量，而解题时间则衡量认知表现。为识别因果效应，我们利用风向引起的当地PM2.5外生变化。研究发现，PM2.5污染对美国锦标赛中简单任务的影响微乎其微，但显著降低了复杂任务的表现速度。在基线PM2.5水平显著更高的印度，我们观察到相似的影响模式，但所有效应均未达到统计显著性。我们证明，这一模式可通过短期PM2.5冲击的边际敏感性随基线PM2.5污染水平升高而递减来解释。研究结果提供了因果证据，表明PM2.5污染的认知成本关键取决于任务复杂度。

title: Quality Adjustment at Scale: Hedonic versus Exact Demand-Based Price Indices
title_zh: 大规模质量调整：享乐指数与精确需求价格指数的比较
authors: Gabriel Ehrlich, John Haltiwanger, Ron Jarmin, David Johnson, Ed Olivares, Luke Pardue, Matthew D. Shapiro, Laura Yi Zhao
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Item-level transactions data yield cost-of-living indices that can account for quality change and consumer substitution. Transactions data require confronting the rapid turnover of items because prices of new and existing products are interrelated in equilibrium. This paper evaluates multiple approaches to measuring quality change at scale. It shows that a hedonic superlative approach—using econometrics or machine learning for hedonic estimation combined with index formulas that require simultaneous observation of item-level price and expenditure—yields improved measures of the cost of living. Accounting for ubiquitous quality change and for consumer substitution yields lower measures of inflation than traditional, official methods. (JEL C43, C45, E31, L15, L81)
abstract_zh: 基于项目级交易数据编制的居民消费价格指数，能够反映质量变化与消费者替代行为。由于均衡状态下新旧产品价格相互关联，交易数据需应对项目快速更替的挑战。本文评估了多种大规模质量变化测算方法，研究表明：采用计量经济学或机器学习进行特征价格估计，并结合需同步观测项目级价格与支出的指数公式，所构建的特征价格超优指数能更精准地衡量生活成本。相较于传统官方统计方法，将普遍存在的质量变化与消费者替代行为纳入考量后，通胀测算结果显著降低。（JEL分类号：C43, C45, E31, L15, L81）
